newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New BM&F head backs Brazil's privatization drive.
newsitem.headline: New BM&F head backs Brazil's privatization drive.

text.p: The Brazilian government and Congress should focus on privatizations and constitutional reforms as soon as discussions on the re-election amendment are over, said the new president of Brazil's BM&F futures exchange.
"Government and Congress should concentrate on the reforms and privatizations in particular," said Manoel Felix Cintra Neto.
He will replace Manoel Pires da Costa who headed the exchange for five years.

Congress began on Monday a month-long extraordinary session with a constitutional amendment that would allow President Fernando Henrique Cardoso the chance for a second term the hottest issue on its packed agenda.

Cintra Neto also expressed his concern over the effects of the new CPMF tax on foreign investment in Brazil's capital markets. The CPMF tax, which will take effect as of January 25, will levy a 0.2 percent charge on all financial transactions.
"This is a terrible tax. Everywhere foreign investors only pay in their home country," he said.
